03Selected work
03Accessibility by default

Patterns are part of the practice.

Keyboard: every interactive element has a visible focus treatment and follows a logical tab order.

Structure: pages use landmarks, one main heading and meaningful section headings.

Motion: movement is restrained and reduced when a visitor prefers less motion.

Contrast: text and controls use the shared palette with readable contrast as a design constraint.

04Maintaining the system

Add with intention.

  1. Start with an existing token or component before introducing another.
  2. Keep names and code in the shared component module; update the documentation with the code.
  3. Check the pattern at mobile, tablet and desktop widths.
  4. Verify keyboard use, reduced motion, readable contrast and heading order whenever a pattern changes.
  5. Use confirmed project details and approved imagery only. Keep portfolio cards out until the work is ready to share.
